2. **O5, traceability.** Each closure estimate would be traceable to the gauge readings it came from. This project will need that once O2's daily outlook is something people act on, because a surprising risk number has to be checked against its readings. My proposal is to approve it as an outcome ("each closure estimate traceable to the gauge readings it came from") and rank it 3rd in Track A's list, after O3. Or you can decline it.
3. **O4 moves to a new Track B (known progression): closure-history map.** It would have one stage that builds the map from the real closure log. It runs after Track A's Stage 1, unless you rank Track B first.

If you say "approve", I'll record all three, update the file and commit it on `main`. Then I'll hand off the first stage. If you want something different, tell me which part to change.
